title: Scroll bars on menu scroll boxes: a track and thumb with arrows at both ends, drawn with the existing line drawing
description:
User request 2026-10-03, follow-on to VIEW-12 (the model menu's two MenuScrollBox boxes). Each scroll box shows a vertical scroll bar at its right edge when its rows overflow: a track, a thumb sized to the visible fraction and placed by the scroll offset, and an arrow at each end. Clicking an arrow scrolls one row; dragging the thumb scrolls proportionally; clicking the track pages. Draw it with the codebase's existing line drawing (the 2D line / LineSDF path the other UI uses), not a new primitive or shader. No bar when everything fits. Rows wrap to the width left of the bar.

Added 2026-10-03: the user reported they can no longer click models in the ring-tool scene's menu. Cause found during CRAW-37: while the ring or region tool is active it takes every click (OrbitMouseTrap toolClick/toolGrab) before the menu's click handling, so menu rows cannot be clicked. While the menu is open and the cursor is over its strip, clicks, presses and drags belong to the menu (rows, arrows, thumb, track), never to the active tool or the orbit, the same way the wheel already does through OrbitMouseTrap.WheelClaimer.

Rework 2026-10-03 (user review, encapsulation): OrbitMouseTrap must know nothing about the menu and ModelScene nothing about scroll bars. Today OrbitMouseTrap declares WheelClaimer and PressClaimer and a pressClaimers list, and ModelScene.initPanes pushes the two scroll bars plus a strip lambda into it. Replace this with one generic pointer-region mechanism in the input layer that knows no concrete client: generalise MouseTrap's existing scroll-region subscriptions (subscribeScrollRegion / ScrollHandler / scrollHandlerUnderCursor) into regions that can take the wheel (tick counts, as VIEW-17 needs), presses, drags and releases while they report themselves active; every MouseTrap, OrbitMouseTrap included, consults that one registry before its own camera or tool handling, through a base-class path with no per-subclass claimer types. The menu registers itself: SceneModelMenu subscribes its own strip and dispatches internally to its boxes and their scroll bars, so ModelScene only creates the menu. WheelClaimer (from VIEW-12/VIEW-17) moves into the same mechanism. Do this after VIEW-17 lands, on top of it.

Correction after VIEW-17 landed (2026-10-03): the wheel is no longer tick counts. Master's MouseTrap queues the raw float delta (queuedScrollDelta) and ScrollHandler already has claimsWheel() and onScrollDelta(double); OrbitMouseTrap.WheelClaimer is gone. Build the pointer-region mechanism on that: the region takes the untruncated float delta, plus press, drag and release. The PressClaimer in this worktree is the last claimer type to fold in.

Rework 2 (user review, 2026-10-03): the template-method split is rejected. Making MouseTrap.mouseButton/moveOrDrag/mouseDragged/paintUpdate final and adding unclaimedMouseButton/unclaimedMoveOrDrag/unclaimedMouseDragged/unclaimedPaintUpdate hooks duplicates every input method under two names, renames every subclass override, and puts routing state (pressHolder, pressHolderDownX/Y) in the base class. Instead put routing in front of the trap by composition: one dispatcher object (in ixdar.platform.input) owns the PointerRegion registry, the press holder and the queued wheel delta. Every event source (LwjglPlatform/WebPlatform callbacks via Scene, AutomationInputBinder, the automation drag route) calls the dispatcher; it offers the event to regions first and forwards only what is left to the trap's ordinary, original-named methods. MouseTrap and its subclasses (OrbitMouseTrap, TradeMouseTrap, Scene2DMousePanTrap, FlyCamMouseTrap) keep their pre-VIEW-16 method names, nothing final, no unclaimed* methods, no pressHolder, and know nothing about regions. Clients register regions with the dispatcher, not with MouseTrap.
definition-of-done:
1. Both boxes show a bar only when they overflow; thumb size and position track the scroll (screenshots at top, middle and end). 2. Arrows scroll one row, thumb drag and track click work, and none of them moves the camera. 3. Drawn with the existing line drawing (named in the report). 4. Rows wrap left of the bar.

6. With the ring tool and with the region tool active, clicking a model row in the open menu loads it and leaves the rings, draft and selection unchanged; clicks outside the strip still reach the tool.

7. OrbitMouseTrap and ModelScene reference no menu, scroll-box or scroll-bar type; the input layer's region interface names no client; SceneModelMenu registers and routes its own input. All earlier VIEW-16 and VIEW-17 behaviour and tests still pass (wheel steps, bar actions, menu clicks over tools, zoom outside the menu).

All VIEW-16 behaviour (bars, arrows, thumb drag, track paging, menu clicks win over the ring and region tools) and VIEW-17 behaviour (continuous float-delta scrolling, fractional zoom) still hold, with their tests passing.

No unclaimed* methods exist; MouseTrap and its subclasses carry no region registry or press-holder state and their input methods keep their master names (the diff to the four trap subclasses is limited to what the region removal requires); routing lives in one dispatcher that every event source goes through.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test for thumb size and position from rows, box height and offset. 2. F5 the editing scene, open the menu with Ctrl+I, use arrows, thumb and track.
changes-made: New MenuScrollBar (gui/ui/menu): track, thumb sized to the visible share of rows (min 16 px) and placed by drawnScrollOffsetY, chevron arrows at both ends, all stroked with Drawing.getDrawing().sdfLine (SDFLine, the LineSDF line path ShaderCodePane and the grids use); no new primitive or shader. Shown only when MenuScrollBox.maximumScrollOffsetY() > 0. MenuScrollBox.layout wraps at full width, then re-wraps to width minus the 20 px bar when the rows overflow; wheel step and onScroll untouched.

Input: OrbitMouseTrap.PressClaimer (beside WheelClaimer) and a pressClaimers list asked on every left press before toolGrab/toolClick; the claimer gets the drag and release, the camera and the tool get nothing, and a claimed click still reaches the overlay HyperStrings. ModelScene registers both scroll bars plus the open menu's whole strip, so rows load with the ring or region tool active (DoD 6). Arrows scroll one row, track clicks page by visible rows minus one, thumb drag scrolls in proportion. ui-state's scene_menu_box elements now report rowsUsed, scrollBarShown, scrollBarThumbTop and scrollBarThumbLength.

Verified 2026-10-03: MenuScrollBarTest (8 tests: thumb length/position from rows, box height and offset; minimum thumb; no bar when rows fit; arrows/track/thumb drag; hidden menu; rows wrap left of the bar); mvn test 379/0 failures; mvn -q compile clean; ./tools/teavm-build.sh OK; ixd wt done passed. Ring-tool scene via /input routes (tmp/verify_scrollbar.sh): arrows 600->570->540->570, track 570->60->0, thumb drag 130 px -> 296.4, track to end 600, drag to top 0; orbit az/el/dist/target identical throughout, while a control drag in the view orbits. Screenshots tmp/view16-models-top.png, -middle.png, -end.png.

DoD 6 verified (tmp/verify_menu_clicks.sh, tmp/verify_ring_under_strip.sh): with the ring tool and with the region tool active, clicking a model row loaded it (loop_collapse, fertility_ring_pick); strip clicks, drags, arrows, track and thumb left ring draft/undo/error and region selection/lastRow unchanged; clicks outside the strip reached the tools (ring error/draft, region pick). A/B with the mesh under the strip: menu open, two clicks at (800,615) left both tools untouched; menu closed, the same click picked region 1 / drafted a ring (undo 0->1).

Rework 2026-10-03 (encapsulation): one generic pointer-region mechanism in the input layer. New top-level ixdar.platform.input.PointerRegion (replaces MouseTrap.ScrollHandler): onScroll, claimsWheel/onScrollDelta(double) as VIEW-17 landed them, plus claimsPointer/onPress/onDrag/onRelease(x, y, click); it names no client. MouseTrap.subscribeRegion/unsubscribeRegion/regionUnderCursor replace the scroll-region names. MouseTrap's entry points mouseButton, moveOrDrag, mouseDragged and paintUpdate are final: a left press over a region claiming the pointer makes it pressHolder, which alone gets every drag and the release; a region claiming the wheel gets the raw delta; everything else goes to the unclaimed* hooks that OrbitMouseTrap, TradeMouseTrap, Scene2DMousePanTrap and FlyCamMouseTrap now override. OrbitMouseTrap lost PressClaimer, pressClaimers, pressHolder and wheelClaimerUnderCursor; ModelScene lost the region subscriptions and press claimers and only creates the menu and puts its strip in webViews. SceneModelMenu subscribes its two MenuScrollBoxes then its strip in its constructor; a box hands presses and drags to its MenuScrollBar (press/dragTo/release) and clicks to its rows, the strip clicks Recompute and swallows the rest. Tests: new PointerRegionPressTest (press/drag/release over a claiming region never reach the orbit or tool; outside it, or while it does not claim, they do); MenuScrollBarTest, ScrollRegionHitTest adapted; mvn test 404/0; mvn -q compile clean; teavm-build OK. Live ring-tool scene: arrows 600->570->540->570, track 570->60->0, thumb drag 130 px -> 296.4, back to 0, orbit unchanged; wheel -0.05 over the models box 0->4.5, twenty -> 90, no zoom; +0.05 off the menu zooms 3.596->3.574; model rows load with the ring and region tools active and leave ring draft/error and region selection unchanged; A/B with the mesh under the strip: menu open no draft, menu closed draft (undo 0->1); Recompute click reloads. ixd wt done passed.

Rework 2 2026-10-03 (composition): routing moved in front of the trap. New ixdar.platform.input.PointerDispatcher, one per platform (PointerDispatcher.forPlatform(id) / current(), mirroring how the old static per-platform region registry was reached), owns the PointerRegion registry (subscribe/unsubscribe/regionUnderCursor(trap, eligible), parallel regionBounds/regions lists), the press holder and its press/held-cursor positions. Event sources call it with the trap: Scene.bindInputDirect and AutomationInputBinder capture forPlatform(platform) for button and cursor callbacks; AutomationRuntime replay, InjectClick and InjectDrag use current(); SceneInputFrameUpdater calls current().paintUpdate(trap, speedMod). It offers each event to regions first (left press over a claiming region holds press, drags and release, click within CLICK_DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX; the trap's queued wheel delta goes whole once per frame to a wheel-claiming region; for a trap whose usesWheel() is false, the base MouseTrap, a non-claiming region gets the legacy stepped onScroll) and forwards the rest to the trap's own mouseButton/moveOrDrag/mouseDragged/paintUpdate. The wheel queue stays MouseTrap.queuedScrollDelta: Canvas3D and MainScene/TradeScene pump paintUpdate for two traps on one platform each frame, so a platform-wide queue would hand the wheel to whichever pumped first. MouseTrap and OrbitMouseTrap, TradeMouseTrap, Scene2DMousePanTrap, FlyCamMouseTrap are back to master names: nothing final, no unclaimed* methods, no press holder or region registry; the only additions are MouseTrap.usesWheel() (false) and a one-line true override in the four traps, which keeps master's rule that a trap with its own wheel use yields only to claiming regions. Clients (SceneModelMenu, Scene's terminal, MainScene's info/terminal/camera, TradeScene, IrregularGridScene, MenuBox, DropDown, ShaderCodePane) subscribe with PointerDispatcher.current().subscribe. The click-only subscribeClickRegion/ClickHandler stays in MouseTrap.mouseClicked untouched (it takes any button after the hyperstring and menu clicks, so it does not fold into the left-press path). Tests: PointerRegionPressTest and ScrollRegionHitTest drive the dispatcher, plus a new case that a non-claiming region leaves the wheel to the orbit zoom; MenuScrollBarTest, MenuScrollBoxWrapTest unchanged; mvn test 405/0; mvn -q compile clean; teavm-build OK. Live ring-tool scene: arrows 105->135->105->75->105, track 105->0, thumb drag 130 px -> 296.4, track to end 600, drag to top 0, orbit unchanged throughout, control drag in the view orbits (az 0.785->1.185); wheel -0.05 over the models box 0->4.5, twenty -> 90, distance unchanged, +0.05 off the menu zooms 268.52->266.88; model rows load with the ring tool (merged_cell_slot) and region tool (fertility_rings) active, strip clicks/drags/arrows/track/thumb leave ring draft/undo/error and region selection unchanged, clicks outside reach both tools; A/B under the strip: menu open undo 0, menu closed undo 1; Recompute click reloads the model. ixd wt done passed.
